pass_1_argument_and_meaning.purpose: Define computer-use scope through software-state interaction without fixing architecture or unrestricted autonomy.
Distinguish interface modalities and document the concrete relationship required for hybrid tool use.
Separate UI understanding, action prediction and complete task execution while allowing human intervention.
Establish pre-foundation-model roots in editable demonstrations, collaboration and screenshot scripting.
Distinguish mobile task automation from a reusable interface corpus.
Trace executable web learning environments and correctly separate MiniWoB from its later extension.
Distinguish representation learning and demonstration datasets from interactive recovery evidence.
Compare simulated shopping and recorded real-website tasks without inflating live-action claims.
Explain the move toward outcome evaluation while retaining environment/platform constraints.
Synthesize overlapping historical threads without claiming linear replacement or causal superiority.
Frame eight prior-survey comparisons by documented emphasis and exact inspected revisions.
Recognize existing work on assets, trust and efficiency and avoid an unsupported novelty/absence claim.
State this manuscript’s complementary paper-to-artifact emphasis as its own editorial aim.
Disclose bounded selection and actual reading levels separately from inventory coverage.

checks: No invented experiment, score or cross-benchmark ranking.
Survey comparison uses stated focus, not absence checkboxes.
Static UI tasks, offline action matching, simulated web and controlled interactive execution remain distinct.
Readable English; no internal task IDs or filesystem paths in main prose.
Citation keys resolve to frozen canonical records.
Reading and inventory counts explicitly separated.
limitations: Root must inspect integrated rendered HTML; this agent did not perform browser/layout verification.
The 20 full-text inspections cover listed relevant sections, not every page, appendix or cited experiment.
